# LG webOS TV (`webos`)

An LG TV with webOS on the local network: power, inputs and the remote's buttons. Paired once with a prompt on the TV; turned on with Wake-on-LAN.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/webos`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/webos/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/webos/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `tv` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- A websocket to the device, port 3000
- A websocket to the device, port 3001
- Wake-on-LAN packets

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | TV address | URL (ws, wss) | yes |  | ws://<address>:3000, or wss://<address>:3001 with the certificate's SHA-256 below. Newer TVs only offer wss. |
| `cert_sha256` | Certificate SHA-256 | text, at most 64 | no |  | For wss only, and required there: the SHA-256 of the TV's certificate in hex. Only that certificate is ever accepted. |
| `wol_mac` | MAC address | MAC address | no |  | The TV's MAC address, for Wake-on-LAN. Without it the TV can be turned off but not on. |
| `wol_broadcast` | Wake-on-LAN broadcast | host:port | no |  | Where the wake packet goes, as IP:port. 255.255.255.255:9 when empty. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_key` | Client key | yes | Handed out by the TV when its pairing prompt is accepted. The setup stores it; nobody types it. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.

## Words for voice

- Heard `lgtv`, meant `lg tv`
- `lg` names the class `tv`
